purpose: Determine whether SMP can support an independent, multi-species test of breeding-component concentration without inspecting concentration outcomes before panel eligibility is frozen.

primary_spatial_hierarchy.secondary_optional: site x species with named plots as components if longitudinal plot continuity metadata are supplied

provisional_panel_gate_frozen_before_rec.component_roster: Use only child sites with stable identity/crosswalk across the retained interval.
provisional_panel_gate_frozen_before_rec.complete_season_definition: Every retained child site has an explicit count or explicit nil return in that season.
provisional_panel_gate_frozen_before_rec.missing_rule: No record or unknown coverage is missing, never zero.
provisional_panel_gate_frozen_before_rec.unit_rule: All retained component records within a population panel must use the same biological count unit or an externally documented equivalent.
provisional_panel_gate_frozen_before_rec.method_rule: Exclude method transitions lacking documented comparability.
provisional_panel_gate_frozen_before_rec.merge_rule: Never combine merged master/site totals with their constituent component records.

feasibility_success: At least 10 master_site x species panels from at least 5 seabird species pass the metadata-only gate, with at least two distinct taxonomic/ecological guilds represented.
feasibility_strong_success: At least 25 eligible panels from at least 10 species pass the metadata-only gate.
feasibility_failure: Fewer than 10 eligible panels, or component identity cannot be reconstructed without outcome-informed manual decisions.
outcome_blind_stop_rule: Do not calculate N_eff, kappa, concentration slopes, abundance trends, or any outcome-dependent statistic before the eligibility roster is frozen.
Coverage, identifiers, units, methods, dates, explicit zero flags and boundary/crosswalk metadata may be inspected.
If the feasibility gate fails, retain the frozen Ecology Report as the primary paper and do not rescue SMP eligibility by lowering thresholds after seeing counts.
